## Overview

This setting includes the standard D&D common and uncommon races, with origins tied to the cosmology of the Originals. All mortal races were created by the Originals (A, B, and C) and placed upon the Material Plane. The gods' claims of having created the races are a calculated deception.

## Common Races

The following common races exist in this setting:

- **Dwarf** (hill and mountain)
- **Elf** (High Elf, Wood Elf, plus Drow and Shadow Elf as subraces)
- **Halfling**
- **Human**
- **Dragonborn**
- **Gnome** (forest and rock)
- **Half-Elf**
- **Half-Orc**
- **Tiefling**

Drow and Shadow Elves are elven subraces with unique origins tied to the Crimson Covenant's experiments.

## Uncommon Races

Only **Genasi** exist among the uncommon races. All other exotic races (Aarakocra, Goliath, Firbolg, Tabaxi, Kenku, Tortle, Goblinoids, Orc, Yuan-ti, etc.) are excluded from this setting for now.

## True Origins

All standard mortal races were created by the Originals — A, B, and C — during their experiments that produced the Material Plane. The Material Plane was the Originals' final successful experiment, designed to sustain self-aware, evolving mortal life. The Originals populated it with diverse races, each adapted to different environments and purposes, and brought them to live on the Material Plane.

## The Crimson Covenant Experiments

Three races were NOT created by the Originals. They are the result of experiments conducted by a shadowy organization known as the Crimson Covenant:

- **Drow & Shadow Elves**: The Covenant grafted demonic tissue onto elven subjects. The survivors became Drow (gaining sunlight sensitivity) and Shadow Elves. Drow fled to the **Underdark** beneath the continent. Shadow Elves escaped to the **Shadowfell** and claimed it as their domain.
- **Tieflings**: The Covenant later experimented on humans using the same demonic tissue grafts. Survivors became Tieflings, who scattered and integrated among the other races.
- The Covenant experimented on elves first, then moved to humans.

## Half-Races

Half-Elves and Half-Orcs exist through natural interbreeding between races. No custom hybrid races exist at this time.

## The Deception

The gods each claim to have created a specific mortal race. This is a deliberate lie designed to maintain their legitimacy, harvest worship, and keep mortals dependent on them. In truth, no god created any race. The specific mapping of which god claims which race is to be defined in a later lore update, once the individual gods are properly named.

## Lifespans

All races follow standard Fifth Edition lifespan ranges:
- Dwarves: ~350 years
- Elves: ~750 years
- Halflings: ~250 years
- Humans: ~100 years
- Dragonborn: ~80 years
- Gnomes: ~500 years
- Half-Elves: ~200 years
- Half-Orcs: ~75 years
- Tieflings: ~100 years
- Genasi: ~120 years

## Racial Homelands

Due to the monster invasion that began 400 years ago and the subsequent reconquering (starting 200 years ago), traditional racial homelands have been largely disrupted. All mortal races now coexist in the three capital cities of the Last Stand and in the reconquered territories to the south and east, living side by side out of shared necessity for survival.
